notes.title: Magic Dinosaurs - Paleontologist & Alchemist bundle!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Players![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25728714/c9561967eefa7d4b36be86176fd0fca55dec344f.png[/img]

[h3]Our bundle Paleontologist & Alchemist just got expanded with Designer DLC![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25948/Paleontologist__Alchemist/

With Designer DLC, you can [b]paint life-sized dinosaur models of all species available in the game.[/b] Grim black T-Rex? Earthly brown triceratops? Or maybe you want to go all out and create the most attention-catching dinosaur possible? Nothing is impossible!

Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jujck4k-jy8

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25728714/9139088d396e48411ff78dd7271709506f13d57a.png[/img]

[b]Designer DLC contains:[/b]

- 10 Dinosaur species to paint
- 10 poses for each Dinosaur species to arrange your display
- 2 gameplay modes:
-- Normal (which takes game progression into account)
-- Sandbox (which allows you to paint every Dino from start)
- 50+ textures for skin, scales etc...
- 30+ skin patterns and decals
- 20+ blood decals
- Full-color palette
- 130+ texture sets with skins
- 20+ independent textures for free combination with skin textures
- 30+ additional decals for museum decoration in 2 color variants

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25728714/0b2aeab2e8113b232f80d6ee63f611a67e90bea3.png[/img]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2065550/Dinosaur_Fossil_Hunter__Designer_DLC/

[b]That's not all![/b]

Next month another DLC - [b]Raptor[/b] will also be added to this bundle!

[b]The Raptor DLC will include:[/b]
- new Dinosaur species: Utahraptor ostrommaysi
- new active dig sites on the Dinosaur Canyon location
- 10 skeleton poses
- 252 unique bones

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2217690/Dinosaur_Fossil_Hunter__Raptor_DLC/

notes.title: Patch Notes #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35238896/71b8325b5a3f8efae8f0c214c40ad293a3d7d41e.png[/img]

Fellow Alchemists,

we’re still working on improving our game and now we have great news for you! ːsteamhappyː Another boost is coming to our game, a bunch of things added or fixed to Make Brewing Potions Easier Again…! Or something like that. ːsteamfacepalmː

Here is the list of the fixed bugs and new features:
[list]
[*] processed ingredients don't vanish from the shelf (new feature),
[*] canceling active quest (new feature),
[*] additional pop-up text while selling/returning potion,
[*] added inverted mouse option in the settings,
[*] added VSync toggle option in the settings,
[*] FOV camera fixed on Almanach,
[*] improved delivery box mechanic,
[*] some translation improvements.
[/list]
We're always open to your suggestions, so feel free to contact us if have some idea about what you want to see in Alchemist Simulator! ːsteammockingː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1105040/Alchemist_Simulator/

notes.title: Patch Notes #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35238896/b0b4bb0b3a9fe4b9980c90131e29ae6a84b92baa.png[/img]

Greetings fellow Alchemists,

thank you all for the feedback regarding our game! Based on your suggestions and information, we made some fixes/improvements, which are live... now ːsteamhappyː:

[list]
[*] crashing the game (XBox controller issue)
[*] additional information about putting back knife after sharpening
[*] add arrows in the Graph of Aspects
[*] appropriate counting down days left while making a quest
[*] disappearing/falling into the floor
[*] graphics improvements in Credits
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1105040/Alchemist_Simulator/
